transcript.text: I want to add one thing about the sesame allergy that I think is important for the plan. Sesame can hide in unexpected places -- things like tahini in hummus, sesame oil in marinades or dressings, sesame seeds on breads or rolls, and sometimes even in spice blends or processed ingredients. So when we're adapting Aunt June's lentil pie recipe to be gluten-free, we'll also need to check every ingredient for sesame, not just the obvious ones. The ingredient labels on each dish will really help with this, but I'd also suggest that whoever is cooking or sourcing food checks labels carefully -- sesame isn't always listed as plainly as you'd expect.
